text: The agent sandbox has no container engine (no Docker/Podman), so @QuarkusTest tests that rely on Dev Services/Testcontainers fail at discovery; PRs must state which tests did not run.
The shared GitHub token has only repo+workflow scopes: `gh pr edit --add-label` fails (needs read:org); add labels via `gh api -X POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>/labels -f "labels[]=<label>"`.
